Read the full architecture as text

Ingest checksum-verified raw files → validate fields and relationships → classify duplicate, stale and updated versions → commit canonical records and the recovery ledger together → build Parquet snapshots → atomically publish the snapshot pointer → inspect durable stage history. Recovery precedes any new mutation.

Engineering decisions

Canonical changes and the committed ledger share one transaction. A sequential controller preserves the existing recovery boundaries. Analytical group keys and measures are checked against independently calculated expectations, including late corrections and tombstones.

A defect worth documenting

A healthy demo initially inherited a history error from an unrelated corrupted fixture. Root filtering was corrected, targeted tests were added, and the full suite and demo were repeated. The original defect evidence was retained.

Limits and reproduction

This is a single-writer Windows implementation. Canonical processing is incremental, but Parquet snapshots rebuild in full. History is bounded and is not tamper-proof. The runtime directory is configurable, with a per-user local default. Independent copied-source execution was verified using existing dependencies. Clean-room installation was not tested, and deeply nested Windows paths remain limited.

Existing environment commands: python -B -m pytest tests -q and python -B -m mediflow demo --config config/demo.toml. Dependencies and runtime approval are required; these are not fresh-machine setup instructions.

IN DEVELOPMENT · ARCHITECTURE STAGE

Agentic DataOps

From a failed run to an explainable investigation.

02

A planned operations layer for evidence validation, incident detection, bounded investigation, and human-reviewed recommendations. The architecture and evaluation approach are documented; the application is not implemented.

Proposed: PythonSQLiteEvidence contracts
Observe→Investigate→Review
Design and evaluation approach

Begin with deterministic diagnostics and standalone synthetic incident fixtures. Reject corrupt evidence, abstain when evidence is missing, and compare detector outcomes against labeled held-out cases. Model-assisted investigation is separately gated.

What is not claimed

No working agent, AI score, autonomous remediation, sandbox validation, live dashboard, or production incident response is verified. Planned isolated fix validation requires an approved execution boundary and protected regression tests.
